About our brand and products:

Australian Wade is an Australian-owned, Australian-made supplier of eco-friendly household essentials — including recycled toilet paper, paper towels, facial tissues, and locally produced cleaning products. Our paper products are made from 100% Australian recycled paper, with no added dyes, inks, or unnecessary chemicals. We specialise in practical, sustainable bulk household items delivered straight to homes, schools, sports clubs, and community groups.

What makes us different:

We’re proudly Australian-made, Australian-owned, and one of the few brands using genuinely Australian recycled paper — not imported “eco” alternatives with unclear origins. Our products are healthier, cleaner, and better for the planet, with bulk packaging that reduces plastic waste. We prioritise transparency, honest sustainability, no greenwashing, and practical value for families. Customers love that our products last longer (extra-long 400-sheet rolls), feel good to use, and support local jobs.

How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates earn a commission on every referred order through their unique link or discount code. Whether you're a content creator, eco-advocate, mum influencer, community leader, or simply love recommending good Australian products, you can earn for every sale you help generate. We offer competitive commission rates, reliable tracking, and regular payouts.

How to promote us:

Promote us through:

  • Social media posts, reels, stories, or TikToks

  • Reviews and unboxing videos

  • Eco-friendly, zero-waste, or Australian-made content

  • Mum-life, home organisation, and cleaning content

  • Community groups, school P&Cs, sports clubs, and fundraising audiences

  • Blog articles or product roundups

  • Word-of-mouth recommendations
    Use your personalised link or discount code to help your audience save while you earn.

Other information:

We welcome influencers, Australian-made advocates, sustainable lifestyle creators, mums, bloggers, and community groups of all sizes. You don’t need a large following — authenticity and local impact matter more. Affiliates receive a dedicated dashboard to track clicks, conversions, and payouts. Our products are ideal for repeat purchases, making ongoing commissions easy.
